headline: Oil India Discovers Natural Gas in Krishna-Godavari Basin
summary: State explorer Oil India Limited has found natural gas in a previously unexplored formation in the shallow Krishna-Godavari Basin off India's east coast.
why: Oil India Limited is a major state-backed exploration and production company whose reserve discoveries impact domestic energy supply.

impacts.name: Oil India Ltd
impacts.why: New natural gas reserves expand the company's asset base and future production potential.
